data_policy: Existing public aggregates only; no new statistical analysis, omitted measured detector cells, or changed frozen metrics.

figures.caption: The adapted response signal helps the small judge; the new local sentence display harms it.
The high baseline measures judge answers: 37/48, 43/48 and 45/48 without probe assistance.
Every measured detector is retained, including unsuccessful comparisons and unavailable Opus cells.
The small judge gains eight fixes with the response probe and incurs nine new errors with the sentence probe.
High role AUROC is a separate measurement from sentence truth and from judge uplift.
Wrong-assigned responses still contain supported claims; correct-assigned responses can contain contradicted claims.
Only Haiku provides distinct repeated generations; three of 265 answer pairs differ, within two of 97 groups.
